
This vignette analyzes a simulated ADNI-style trial using
`pmrm_delayed()` with profile-likelihood delay estimation.

```{r setup}
library(pmrmPlus)
data(adni_simulated)

fit <- tryCatch(
  pmrm_delayed(adas_cog ~ time * trt, data = adni_simulated,
               delay_estimation = "profile",
               delay_grid = seq(0, 18, by = 3), lambda = 0.5),
  error = function(e) e
)
if (!inherits(fit, "error")) {
  print(fit)
  s <- summary(fit)
  head(s$t_table)
} else {
  message("Demo fit skipped: ", conditionMessage(fit))
}
```

The profile log-likelihood and its chi-squared threshold give an
approximate confidence interval for the onset delay.
